name: Obeying The Law
overview: Scripture teaches that obedience to the law is essential, emphasizing that true justification comes not from merely hearing the law but from actively doing it, as Romans 2:13 highlights. The law is not nullified by faith; rather, faith establishes its rightful place (Romans 3:31). Believers are called to respect and submit to governing authorities since all power is ordained by God (Romans 13:1; Titus 3:1), yet this submission must never supersede obedience to God, as Peter and the apostles declared the necessity of obeying God rather than men (Acts 5:29).
